headlines.title: US and Iran Trade New Strikes as the War Enters its 7th Month
headlines.description: The United States and Iran are exchanging new attacks across the Middle East, following days of renewed threats from both sides. CENTCOM says the U.S. struck Iranian air defense sites, radar systems and other military targets in response to Iran’s recent attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Thousands of U.S. service members arrive in Thailand after record stint at sea
headlines.description: About 5,000 U.S. sailors and Marines are stopping in the resort city of Pattaya for a “rest and relaxation” break as they return home from a record-setting deployment in the Middle East.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy jury tells judge they’re still deadlocked on 5th day of deliberations
headlines.description: Jurors in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial told the judge on Wednesday they were deadlocked for a second time, a day after they issued a first deadlock note to the judge on Tuesday.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick believes Jay-Z has a ‘guilty conscience’ over deals with NFL and Target
headlines.description: Kaepernick made the comments as part of an extensive interview with NBC News ahead of the release of his memoir, “The Perilous Fight.”

headlines.title: Arizona congressman heard ‘freight train crash’ sound during Grand Canyon flash flood
headlines.description: Rep. David Schweikert, R-Ariz., said he heard what sounded like “a freight train smashing into a boulder” as a Grand Canyon flash flood consumed the landscape near his rafting group Saturday.

headlines.title: Ariana Grande tearfully ends 41-show tour and steps back from public life
headlines.description: A teary and visibly emotional Ariana Grande bid farewell to her fans as her 41 show tour concluded in London and she began her planned withdrawal from public life.

headlines.title: Customers are losing their appetites over disturbing AI-generated menus
headlines.description: AI “slop” is increasingly on offer at brick-and-mortar establishments.

headlines.title: JD Vance talks end times, Antichrist and AI on faith podcast
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance warned about the dangers of artificial intelligence Tuesday and said he wouldn’t be “shocked” if we were living in the “end times” and the Antichrist was walking the Earth.

headlines.title: Forget crude oil. The real energy crisis right now is in diesel.
headlines.description: The average price of diesel gas hit its highest level since the Iran war started, as a global supply bottleneck tightened and seasonal demand is poised to rise.

headlines.title: DOJ sues Kansas school district over transgender student guidelines and parental consent
headlines.description: In what it called “a first-of-its-kind lawsuit,” the Justice Department has sued a school district in Kansas over its guidelines on student gender identity and assisting transgender students.
